mainLanguage.description: プロジェクト全体の主要プログラミング言語（例: "rust"）。graphify 側で静的に確定する。PX-25 以降の boundify パイプラインで使用。

distributionDigest.description: The digest of the RFC distribution-map this graph was built from. Optional: a graph that predates the map remains valid.

formulaDigest.description: The digest of the formula sidecar content this graph carries. Optional: a graph that predates the formula ledger remains valid.

contractChain.description: Whether non-registry edge contracts are state transitions that must close. Absent means obligation: the node-chain and inter-ticket chain proofs are skipped.
